content: The ego is not what you are. The ego is what the world thinks you are.
author: Osho
sourceWork: The Book of Secrets (Vigyana Bhairava Tantra)
story:
From the university lecture halls of Jabalpur to the bustling ashram in Pune, Osho challenged institutional dogmas, religious orthodoxies, and societal hypocrisies. Synthesizing Zen, Sufism, Tantra, and Western therapy, he introduced dynamic meditation techniques designed to shake modern individuals out of obsessive mental chatter into spontaneous, authentic aliveness.

In formulating this reflection, Osho stripped away superficial conventions to address the core anatomy of ego. For Osho, true wisdom is never an abstract luxury, but an urgent practical discipline required to navigate life with clarity and unshakeable dignity.
reflectionPrompt: In what area of your life are you overthinking the ideal approach instead of taking the simple, honorable action?
